column1: # The regex is matched against the lowercased PROGRAM only: argv[0], plus the
# script/module when argv[0] is an interpreter (node, python, npx, sh, ...).
# Other arguments are ignored, so `tmux new -s claude` or `vim CLAUDE.md` never
# match. First match wins. Columns are TAB separated. # lines are ignored.
# Several lines may share a category (ide: VS Code and Cursor); each line's
# label is what the email says, the category picks template and stale rule.
